next.approval: Next: an approver decides this return.
next.receive: Next: the warehouse receives the goods into quarantine.
next.credit: Next: finance issues the credit note.
next.done: Done: the goods are in quarantine and the customer was credited.
next.closed: This return was rejected; nothing was received or credited.

request.title: Request a return
request.pickOrder: Choose the delivered order the goods come from.
request.noOrders: No delivered orders to return from.
request.openReturns: This order already has open returns:
request.nothingReturnable: Nothing on this order can be returned: everything delivered and invoiced is already returned or requested.
request.help: Enter the quantity for each line and lot that comes back, with a reason. Leave a line empty to keep it.
request.invoicedOnly: Only invoiced goods can be returned for now. Goods delivered but not yet invoiced need their invoice first.
request.notesPlaceholder: Example: outer box crushed in transit
request.notesHelp: Optional, unless the reason is Other. No patient data.

check.noLines: Enter a quantity on at least one line.
check.tooMany: A quantity is more than can be returned on that line.
check.missingReason: Choose a reason for every line you return.
check.notesRequired: Explain the reason Other in the notes.

detail.requestedOk: Return requested. It now waits for approval.
detail.estimateHelp: Estimates use the order line price. The credit note is computed from the invoice lines, with VAT, when finance credits the return.

receive.title: Receive into quarantine
receive.intro: Count the goods, then receive them. Returned stock stays in quarantine and is not sellable until an inventory manager releases it.
receive.noQuarantine: There is no active quarantine warehouse. Ask an administrator to create one.

credit.title: Credit the customer
credit.intro: Issues the credit note for the returned lines at their invoiced prices, with VAT. Estimate: {amount}.

errors.QTY_EXCEEDS_RETURNABLE: A quantity is more than was delivered and invoiced, minus earlier returns. Reload and check the lines.
errors.WAREHOUSE_NOT_QUARANTINE: Returned goods can only be received into a quarantine warehouse.
errors.CREDIT_QTY_EXCEEDED: Part of this return is already credited on the invoice by another credit note.
errors.EXCEEDS_INVOICE_OPEN_AMOUNT: The credit is more than what is still open on the invoice. Finance must reverse a payment allocation first.
errors.IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: This request was already used for another record. Reload the page and try again.
errors.SELF_APPROVAL: You cannot decide your own request.
errors.REASON_REQUIRED: Explain the reason in the notes.
errors.INVALID_STATE: This return or order is not in a state that allows this. Reload the page.
errors.PERMISSION_DENIED: You do not have permission for this.
errors.NOT_FOUND: Not found, or you cannot see it.
errors.VALIDATION: Some values are not valid. Check the form.
errors.CONFLICT: Someone changed this at the same time. Reload the page.
errors.UNAVAILABLE: The service is unavailable. Try again. (ref {requestId})
errors.MFA_REQUIRED: This action needs a code from your authenticator app. Open My security (Account security), verify this session, then try again.
